reference_sql:
SELECT country_code,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(units) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'web') / SUM(units), 1) AS web_units_pct
FROM sales
GROUP BY country_code
alternatives: SELECT country_code, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN units ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(units), 1) AS web_units_pct FROM sales GROUP BY country_code
SELECT country_code, ROUND(100 * CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN units END) AS DOUBLE) / SUM(units), 1) AS web_units_pct FROM sales GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT country_code, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN units ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(units), 1) AS web_units_pct FROM sales GROUP BY country_code
other_way.tradeoff: Works in every SQL dialect, but is wordier than FILTER.
